name: Hargeisa (Somaliland)
description: A green field charged with the white silhouette of the twin Naasa Hablood hills, with the letters 'D.H.H' above.
history: The flag of the Hargeisa local government, the capital of the self-declared Republic of Somaliland, shows the Naasa Hablood hills that overlook the city. It is documented from photographs; no adoption date has been published.

features.symbolism: the landmark hills outside the city
